resources.string: CheapTrip is a unique search engine that finds the cheapest ways between cities, combining flights, buses, trains and ferries.
Matter Of Choice presents interactive scenarios to help you learn decision-making skills.

On-device AI now sees pictures: the chat models download their vision part with them. Attach a photo in the on-device Chat (+), and mini-apps with a photo get an on-device answer too, from a model that can see.
Models: an Images filter, the vision part\'s download (paused and resumed like the model), and a check on this phone that now asks image questions as well.
Settings → On-device AI turns the mini-app answers on or off.
